home.heroTitle: Understand them better. Love them longer.
home.heroSubtitle: Turning invisible technology into visible peace of mind.
home.heroCopy: Turning invisible technology into visible peace of mind.
home.featureOne: Works for cats, dogs, and custom item names
home.featureTwo: One account can bind multiple tags
home.manifestoBodyOne: We believe every moment spent with a pet is one of life's purest gifts. Our name is meouwow, and we exist for one simple, warm wish: understand them better, love them longer.
home.manifestoBodyTwo: We know they cannot speak. But every joyful run and every calm breath tells us something about their health and emotions. We listen to these silent languages with care, turning invisible technology into visible peace of mind.
home.manifestoBodyThree: What we protect is not only health, but the one-of-a-kind understanding between you and your furry family.
home.manifestoQuote: Every interaction should bring simple happiness and lasting warmth.
home.missionBlockTitle: Make love lighter and companionship longer
home.missionCopy: Create warm, thoughtful products for pet families, making love lighter and companionship longer.
home.visionCopy: Become a pet movement and health brand that understands life more deeply and earns lasting trust.
home.visionPointOne: For pets and families: bring peace of mind, freedom, and joy to every day.
home.visionPointTwo: For the team: create a loving, cheerful, and ambitious atmosphere.
home.visionPointThree: For partners: build a platform of mutual trust and shared success.
home.missionListTitle: What we want to achieve together
home.missionPointOne: For owners, binding should feel light and profile updates should stay simple.
home.missionPointTwo: For finders, the page should immediately explain what they are seeing and how to help.
home.missionPointThree: For the product, pages, APIs, and schema should be ready to extend naturally.
home.valueOneCopy: Do the right thing, and stay honest and transparent.
home.valueTwoCopy: Every thought begins with what pets truly feel.
home.valueThreeCopy: Technology may be cold, but our original intention is warm.
home.valueFourCopy: Clear states, layered information, and obvious next steps build confidence for both sides.
home.valueFiveCopy: Designed around what actually happens in parks, streets, airports, and taxis.
home.flowTitle: Owner binds first, finder sees later, and one QR code carries the whole journey
home.flowIntro: The homepage should not only feel like a brand page. It also needs to explain the product mechanism clearly from the start.
home.flowStepOneCopy: Scan the tag, create an account, enter the activation code, and save the pet or item profile.
home.flowStepTwoTitle: Finder only sees what they should see
home.flowStepTwoCopy: The Finder page changes with privacy mode and tag status, showing public details, direct contact, or anonymous messaging when appropriate.
home.flowStepThreeTitle: Owner gets scan clues and can react faster
home.flowStepThreeCopy: Scan log fields, lost mode, and map entry points work together to help the owner decide the next move quickly.
home.previewCopy: Local development mode includes sample UIDs for ACTIVE, LOST, and INACTIVE flows.
home.previewActive: Public profile is ready and direct contact or notes can be shown.
home.previewLost: A large red help banner appears at the top and recovery takes priority.
home.previewInactive: The tag is not bound yet, so only the activation hint is visible.
home.scenarioTitle: Built for pets, but also for the important things people leave behind
home.scenarioPetCopy: When a dog or cat is found near a park, apartment, or elevator, the finder can immediately see the name, care notes, contact path, and lost status.
home.scenarioItemCopy: Backpacks, suitcases, keys, and camera bags can use custom names and notes so the page fits real item-recovery situations too.
home.privacyTitle: Privacy is not hiding everything. It is separating what should be public from what should stay protected
home.privacyCopy: The homepage should explain this clearly: the Finder page shows only allowed public data, and the owner can choose between direct contact and privacy-safe messaging.
home.privacyPointOne: In privacy mode, the finder sees an anonymous message entry instead of a full private phone trail.
home.privacyPointTwo: Show Location opens the finder's current device location in a map, not live pet tracking.
home.privacyPointThree: Scan logs capture time, source, coordinates, city, IP, device info, and notification status for owner review.
home.lostModeTitle: Lost mode should make the urgency impossible to miss
home.lostModeCopy: When the owner switches to LOST, the Finder page immediately shows the red “I AM LOST, PLEASE HELP!” banner so the finder knows this is an active recovery moment.
home.storyTitle: A warm heart, backed by careful craft
home.storyBodyOne: Every meouwow product begins with genuine love for furry companions. We do not show off cold parameters. We lean closer and observe their tiny movements and habits, from free runs under the sun to peaceful sleep late at night. We believe the best technology should not disturb life, but accompany it as gently as air.
home.storyBodyTwo: Like a cat's lazy "meow" and a dog's excited "wow", we hope every interaction brings simple happiness and lasting warmth.
home.storyBodyThree: Behind that warmth is a professional R&D team pursuing detail with discipline. With rigorous algorithms and advanced sensing technology, we try to understand needs that have not yet been spoken. Nothing is made complicated for its own sake. Everything is for making love more understood, and more lasting.
home.faqOne: Why does the Finder page not require login? Fewer steps make it more likely that contact and return actually happen.
home.faqTwo: How many tags can one account bind? The first release supports one account binding multiple anti-loss tags.
home.faqThree: What object types are supported? The data model covers cats, dogs, and custom item names in one structure.
home.faqFour: What does privacy mode mean? A finder can still help make contact, but may not see the owner's full private details directly.
home.faqFive: Whose location does Show Location open? The finder's current device location, not live pet or item tracking.
home.faqSix: Why start with local development mode? The current phase is about aligning pages, APIs, Prisma schema, and state transitions first.
home.contactTitle: You can already run the whole product loop in local mode
home.contactCopy: The current project is aligned on Nuxt 3 + Vue 3 + TypeScript + Pinia + i18n + Prisma, with local development mode as the default path and verification code fixed to 123456.
